label: ODI DFP-34X-2C2 GPON SFP ONT
description: mini-GPON ONT built into an SFP module (Realtek RTL9601D, Linux Luna SDK, SC/UPC BOSA) that presents itself to the host router as an HSGMII Ethernet interface at 2.5 Gbit/s; GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up with no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi, managed over its web UI or SSH.
